userSettings.title: User Settings
userSettings.webdavHint: One account & password for both: WebDAV mounts your files, CalDAV syncs your calendars (DAVx5, Apple Calendar, Outlook, etc.).
userSettings.webdavPasswordHint: Paste this App Password into your WebDAV client along with the account above.
userSettings.noAppPasswords: No App Passwords yet — create one in the App Passwords section first.
userSettings.passwordUnavailable: Can't be re-displayed — create a new one
userSettings.caldavHint: CalDAV server: take the Mount URL above and replace its trailing /dav/files/ with /dav. Same account & password — no separate calendar token needed.
userSettings.icalHint: Subscribe to your personal calendar in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook, etc. No extra parameters needed — subscribing with your own account (email + App Password) yields your personal calendar (private + team-shared events and dated todos).
userSettings.icalPickPassword: Choose the App Password for this subscription:
userSettings.icalNoPassword: Select an App Password above to generate the subscription URLs.
userSettings.icalCombinedUrl: One-click subscribe URL (email & App Password embedded)
userSettings.icalCombinedHint: For clients that only accept a single URL. It contains your credentials — only share it with calendar services you trust.
userSettings.icalBasicHint: Clients such as Apple Calendar or Outlook ask for a username & password when subscribing — fill in the values above.

team.title: Team settings
team.inviteHint: Share this link with people to join; valid for 7 days
team.resetTokenHint: Used for iCal subscriptions & CalDAV Basic Auth (email + token)
team.joinHint: Generate an invite link in team settings, join and auto switch
team.webdavHint: Mount team files via WebDAV for shared access on large screens or network drives.
team.webdavNote: Use team:team_id as the account and the calendar token as the password (read-only, shared/public content only). WebDAV mounts at the URL above; the CalDAV server is /dav under the same origin and lists only the team calendar (no personal calendars).

settings.title: Settings
settings.corsHint: Allow these origins to access calendar subscriptions & WebDAV from the browser. Separate with commas, or use * to allow all
settings.appPasswordsHint: Create App Passwords so external clients (CalDAV, WebDAV, iCal) can sign in as you. You can copy them from this list at any time.
settings.appPasswordCreated: App password created. You can copy it again anytime from the list below.
settings.revokeAppPasswordConfirm: This app password will be permanently deleted. Continue?
settings.sessionsHint: Manage your login sessions. Revoking a session will force it to sign out.
settings.revokeSessionConfirm: This will force the session to sign out. Continue?
